Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine analysis shows significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), positive nitrites, leukocyte esterase, elevated leukocytes, and presence of blood, indicating a urinary tract infection (UTI). The presence of glucose in urine may suggest hyperglycemia or impaired renal threshold. Low specific gravity could indicate dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Clinical correlation and further evaluation for diabetes and UTI management are recommended.
